newsitem.title: USA: ROSS Technology gets $25mln more in credit.
newsitem.headline: ROSS Technology gets $25mln more in credit.

text.p: ROSS Technology Inc said Thursday it has increased, to $50 million, its credit facility with Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd's New York Branch. The Company said the additional $25 million credit facility was guaranteed by Fujitsu Ltd, reaffirming Fujitsu's long-term strategic commitment to ROSS.
ROSS, incorporated in 1988, is a majority-owned subsidiary of Fujitsu. A minority position in ROSS is held by Sun Microsystems Inc.
ROSS is one of the industry's most prominent suppliers of SPARC microprocessors and SPARC system products to both the OEM and end-user markets.
